Chords from top notes

Which chords your pan is considered to have is worked out from its top notes alone. That is what this picker lists and what Suggestions marks.

Chord settings

Chord voicings

Melody cycles

Transitions

A row can end with a run of single notes that leads into the next chord — the groove stands aside while it plays. On by default with Motion, off with Narrow and Wide; either way this switch decides.

Chord suggestions

Mild keeps to plain triads. Hotter lets sevenths, ninths and diminished chords in.

Breaks

Breaks

The jam keeps running underneath the silence. Hold your groove and come back in with it — the first beat of the break still sounds.

How long, how often

During the break

The click can keep the time for you, or leave you to it. The marker either walks the silent bars or waits on the last beat you heard.
